allowed_actions.commands: nonempty list of argument arrays; executed sequentially, then arm feedback is returned. This object has no other fields.

notes: read returns the requested byte range as UTF-8 text, or as base64 bytes when that range is not valid UTF-8; bytes must be at least 1 and at most 49080 per call, and offset pages through a larger file
submit executes the listed commands sequentially in the task work tree and returns arm feedback
the original inputs are already in the task work tree; commands may read them directly, so read is only needed to inspect bytes in context
schema.response_rule: Return exactly one JSON object per turn with a type field at its top level. Do not wrap the action in another object or an array. Do not return prose, multiple objects, or any field not listed here.

system: Complete the task using only the supplied action interface. Read original inputs with read (byte offsets); results return UTF-8 text, or base64 bytes when the requested range is not valid UTF-8. Artifacts live outside context. Submit each complete attempt; at most max_retries additional submissions are allowed. Tool arms submit a complete ordered command batch; verification happens after that batch. Finish only after your final submission. No hidden oracle feedback is available. Resource limits and truncation are failures, not completion. Every response must be exactly one action JSON object.

task.requirement: Read input.csv using CSV-aware parsing; empty value means null. Values are base-10 integers; active is the literal true or false. Filter to active true before grouping by group. Compute sum and arithmetic mean of non-null value per group. Output {"groups": {GROUP: {"sum": INTEGER, "average": NUMBER_OR_NULL}}}. Use null for the average when no non-null values exist. Write only the specified JSON structure to output.json. Do not change input.csv. JSON key order and whitespace do not matter. Integer results are exact; means have absolute tolerance 0.000000001. Include all groups present after filtering.
